en: The Triplet of the Wholesome, the Triplet of Rapture.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor accompanied by rapture, an unwholesome state accompanied by rapture arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of the root condition … pe … three in the case of the resultant condition … pe … nine in the case of the non-disappearance condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor accompanied by pleasure, an unwholesome state accompanied by pleasure arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of the root condition … pe … three in the case of the resultant condition … pe … nine in the case of the non-disappearance condition.

Dependent on a non-virtuous state not accompanied by equanimity, a non-virtuous state accompanied by equanimity arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of root; ... pe ... three in the case of result; ... pe ... nine in the case of non-disappearance.
